title: Japan Super Bass Classic '96
native_title: ジャパン・スーパー・バス・クラシック’９６
overview: Japan Super Bass Classic '96 is a bass fishing game endorsed by pro bass fisher Katsutaka Imae. The player is tasked with winning various tournaments on order to win professional titles; winnings can be used to buy and upgrade equipment, with the player's rod, reel, line and lure all being customizable. The game also includes a practice mode to try out equipment before participating in a tournament.
